annotations.title: Query Seismic Hazards, Elevation, PLATEAU & POIs

cleanProvenanceBadge: 100% First-Party & Open Government Licensed (commercial_resell_ok — Zero ToS-violating portal scraping)
description: Read-only, idempotent spatial query of GSI 1m elevation, J-SHIS hazard, PLATEAU 3D models, and POIs in 47 prefectures (API key or x402; daily). Pass areaOrStation or lat/lon (default radiusKm=10, limit=30, offset=0); returns spatial records ordered by distance ascending. Note: For auctions, use query_court_foreclosures instead.

areaOrStation.default: 東京都千代田区丸の内
areaOrStation.description: Japanese address, municipality, or railway station across any of all 47 prefectures (e.g. "東京都千代田区丸の内", "札幌駅", "大阪市北区", "博多駅").

keyword.description: Optional keyword filter across facilities, corporations, and datasets.

lat.description: Optional latitude in decimal degrees across Japan (20.0 to 46.0, e.g. 35.6812).

limit.description: Maximum spatial POI records to return (1 to 200).

lon.description: Optional longitude in decimal degrees across Japan (122.0 to 154.0, e.g. 139.7671).

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset (0..10000, default 0). Combine with limit to page through large result sets deterministically.

radiusKm.description: Haversine search radius in kilometers for nearby facilities (0.1 to 100, default: 10 km).

name: query_seismic_hazards

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this response payload was generated.

items.description: Spatial records combining GSI 1m elevation, J-SHIS seismic hazard, PLATEAU 3D urban models, and area POIs ordered by Haversine distance ascending.

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset applied to the matched record slice.

partialResult.description: True only if a live upstream sub-source returned partial coverage.

returnedCount.description: Number of structured records returned in items for this page.

sealStatus.description: TAPP Sigstore Rekor cryptographic Merkle seal status of the dataset.

sha256Digest.description: Deterministic 64-character hex SHA-256 provenance digest of the returned items.

stats.description: Execution telemetry including itemCount, durationMs, and upstream breakdown.

streamId.description: Underlying B2A data stream identifier that fulfilled the query.

success.description: True when the read-only query completed without upstream or validation failure.

toolName.description: Executed MCP tool name for deterministic audit correlation.
